title: HF1901 (2023-2024 Regular): Right of the people to keep and bear arms protected, and constitutional amendment proposed.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-02-16; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/1901/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced bill (as filed), 2023-02-16. No votes recorded. Ballot question to be put to voters at the 2024 general election.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Const. art. I, new sec. 18): A well regulated militia, being necessary to the security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed.
Section 2 (ballot question): Shall the Minnesota Constitution be amended to protect the right of the people to keep and bear arms?
